messages.subject: ProblemX_From ProblemX_To
parts:
Hi,

 

One of my cameras has an issue where it will detect something, but the photos would be completely black. This error switches on and off throughout the sampling period. So there are perfectly normal photos and completely black ‘photos’ on the same day.

 

How then should I enter the ProblemX_From, ProblemX_To column?

 

Thanks you!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: ProblemX_From ProblemX_To
parts:
Hi, 
the ProblemX_From, ProblemX_To columns are not made for this kind of problem. It is for situations in which a camera stopped working altogether for a period of time. 

From what I see you have two choices, depending on what the ratio of good vs bad images is:

1) if only few black images, just treat the camera like it worked fine (basically ignore the black images)
2) if many black images and you think you missed many sightings, exclude the station from your analyses. 

Unfortunately, the package currently has no way of correcting for this sort of problem automatically. 
However, if you run occupancy or spatial capture-recapture analyses, you could manually correct the effort matrix by multiplying whatvever value you have in there for that station by the ratio of good / bad images. Then include effort in your models as a detection covariate.
Best,
Jürgen
